headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback to edge out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a standout performance, hitting a grand slam and collecting 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Mike Yastrzemski, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation by the Atlanta Braves. Other notable injuries include Anthony Banda (Minnesota Twins) with a left lat strain, Nick Kurtz (Athletics) with a right thumb capsule sprain, and Kyle Harrison (Milwaukee Brewers) with left forearm tightness.

The Chicago White Sox made a midseason trade, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. Additionally, the Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested matchup, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a standout performance, hitting a grand slam and collecting 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Comeback Falls Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers dropped a 2-3 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates, unable to overcome a late rally. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Angels 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-5 victory over the Los Angeles Angels, with Royce Lewis leading the batting line with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics dropped a 1-0 decision to the Chicago White Sox, failing to capitalize on a strong outing from Gage Jump. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics' offense with a 2-hit performance, including a crucial double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Mike Yastrzemski on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves left fielder Mike Yastrzemski has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The move was made on July 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Make Midseason Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates on July 11, 2026, in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.
